item.description:
First public release.

  • Watch Recordings with a live overlay: each player's resources, villagers, army, idle villagers and idle Town Center time, plus a score table.
  • Timeline: jump to any minute, change speed, switch whose view you watch.
  • Recordings: every match in one list, searchable by player, civ and map, with villager graphs.
  • Friends: follow players and download and watch their recent ranked matches.
  • Leaderboard: the Mac ranked ladder, with stats and recent matches for any player.

Requires Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition (the Mac version on Steam). Recordings made on an older Game build may go out of sync.
